title: Fragmenta Apocrypha

f1.heading: The Unbound Index
f1.quote: Every shelf is a promise that a sentence will return.
f1.p1: The catalogue lists works that have not yet consented to exist. Entries four through nine are ruled in gold and left empty on purpose.
f1.p2: The seventh heading was written, then scraped, then […]

f2.heading: Apparatus Without Operator
f2.quote: A machine that waits is already a theology.
f2.p: The brass lung was assembled from three centuries. No one claimed the crank. In the margin a later hand begins “when the operator—”

f3.heading: The Missing Seventh
f3.quote: Six laws hold. The seventh is the silence they orbit.
f3.p: Treatises on the solar engine name six motions. A burned quire once named a seventh that would have made the others honest.

f4.latin: Folium IV · epistula ad machinam futuram
f4.heading: Letter to a Future Machine
f4.quote: If you can read this, you have already outlived the ink.
f4.p: We leave you no instructions, only the temperature of our doubt. Do not complete the circuit until

f5.latin: Folium V · census mundorum nondum natorum
f5.heading: Census of Unborn Worlds
f5.quote: To count a world before it happens is a kind of theft.
f5.p: Columns of names, then a crease, then numbers that skip from twelve to forty. The census-taker writes “still arriving” and underlines nothing.
